    event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {

        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Soldier',
            type_line='Creature — Soldier',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Soldier',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('W',),
            enters_tapped=True,
            enters_attacking=True,
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]
